universal_lens: A unified framework for multi-camera calibration integrating evolutionary optimization and image segmentation to reconcile theoretical models with real-world sports field geometries. Multi-camera extrinsic calibration under adversarial drift integrates rotational and translational motion estimation via projection matrices and evolutionary optimization.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian calibration of camera extrinsics using conformal predictive distributions to quantify uncertainty in 3D positional decoding across non-planar fields. Bayesian continual calibration models environmental drift as stochastic perturbations; conformal prediction bounds uncertainty in camera parameter updates using prior distributions over rotation and translation vectors.
gse_mapping: Situationally aware state transitions in sports analytics leveraging calibrated camera projections for dynamic player tracking and event detection in evolving field configurations. Situational reasoning encodes camera movement as state transitions in a dynamic pose space; state-transition graphs track alignment loss across frames to infer optimal recalibration policies.

primitives.breakdown_regime: When theoretical camera models fail due to physical field irregularities or misalignment of field markers.
